records.query: Apple 最近有什麼跟 Siri 有關的法律訴訟或和解消息？
records.answer:
Apple 最近因被指在行銷「Enhanced Siri」功能時未實際提供該功能，而在美國加州北區聯邦法院面臨一項集體訴訟，並已同意以約 **2.5億美元** 的金額達成和解，讓符合條件的 iPhone 使用者可獲得最高 **每部 $95** 的賠償【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  

- 訴訟指控 Apple 透過廣告誇大 Siri 的人工智慧功能，導致消費者基於錯誤資訊購買 iPhone 16、iPhone 15 Pro 或 iPhone 15 Pro Max【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 法院文件顯示，和解金額上限為 **2.5億美元**，若獲法院批准，將成為 Apple 歷史上規模最大的和解之一【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 大約 **3700 萬** 名在 **2024 年 6 月 10 日至 2025 年 3 月 29 日** 期間購買上述機型的 iPhone 用戶符合資格【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 符合條件的用戶最初可獲 **每部 $25**，最終賠償金額視申請數量與其他因素而定，但不會超過 **每部 $95**【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- Apple 表示已解決此事，以便專注於「提供最創新的產品與服務」【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。

iPhone owners could receive up to $95 under a proposed $250 million settlement resolving claims that Apple misled customers about Siri's artificial intelligence features, according to a recent court filing. The class-action lawsuit, filed in federal court in the Northern District of California on behalf of U.S. consumers, claims that Apple deceived customers by marketing "Enhanced Siri features" that did not yet exist, leading them to buy iPhones based on false advertising. The plaintiffs are seeking a $250 million settlement payment, according to a recent court filing. If approved by a judge, it could rank among the largest settlements involving Apple. "Apple has reached a settlement to resolve claims related to the availability of two additional features," an Apple spokesperson said in an email to CBS News. "We resolved this matter to stay focused on doing what we do best, delivering the most innovative products and services to our users."
Clarkson Law Firm, a public interest law firm that filed the original lawsuit against Apple, said in a statement on Wednesday that the settlement would provide "timely relief to tens of millions of consumers nationwide."
Here's what to know about the recent settlement. Am I eligible? The settlement covers people who purchased an iPhone 16 model, iPhone 15 Pro or iPhone 15 Pro Max between June 10, 2024, and March 29, 2025. Approximately 37 million iPhone owners are eligible, according to the court filing. Customers will be notified by either email or mail if they can file a claim. An online social media campaign will also provide information about the settlement website and who is eligible, according to the court filing. How much money could I get? Eligible customers will initially receive $25 per device. Depending on how many claims are submitted and other determining factors, the final payment may increase or decrease, but it will not exceed $95 per device, according to the court filing

website
that a settlement website with more details will be available in "a few weeks."

contributed to this report.

records.query: Apple 在最近的 WWDC 上關於 Siri 有什麼新消息？
records.answer:
Apple 在本次 WWDC 上宣布全新 AI 版 Siri（Siri AI），將於今年秋季以測試版（beta）形式在美國英語市場先行推出，並結合 Google Gemini 模型與 Apple Intelligence，讓數位助理能安全地利用個人化上下文、提升資訊檢索與第三方 App 自動化，同時強調隱私與安全性【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】【AAPL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #2】。

- Siri AI 於 WWDC 正式亮相，預計在今年稍後以 beta 方式上線【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 新版 Siri 能從使用者的 App 中抽取上下文資訊，讓使用者只要說出需求（例如「我妹妹在簡訊裡推薦的播客是什麼」）即能直接呈現結果，無需另開 App【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- Apple 透過與 Google 簽署的協議，使用 Google Gemini 系列模型（包括 Gemini Flash‑Lite、Flash、Pro 以及 Image 模型）為 Siri AI 提供算力，且依賴 Google Search 進行世界知識的 grounding；但 Apple 並未使用 Google 向客戶部署的模型或基礎設施【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 同時推出的 Siri 應用程式將更具個人化，並在隱私與安全性上加碼，強調「安全」與「隱私」是產品的核心推力【AAPL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- Apple Intelligence 也將在 Safari 瀏覽器、密碼與訊息應用中發揮作用，支援 Siri AI 的語音輸入與問答功能【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 這次 AI 整合被視為提升 iPhone 成長的關鍵，iPhone 在過去四季的出貨增長了 16%【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 分析師預期 Apple 會以新版 Siri 應用與「Search」或「Ask Prompt」功能（由 Google 提供）對抗 ChatGPT、Grok、Gemini 等競爭對手【AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0】。

After two years of delays, Apple's (
AAPL
) reinvented Siri, Siri AI,
appears ready for primetime
. The company unveiled the AI-powered version of its assistant at its Worldwide Developers Conference in Cupertino, Calif., on Monday, saying it will launch, albeit as a beta, later this year. The update is designed to transform Siri from a glorified kitchen timer to a
digital helper for the AI age
. Apple said Siri AI will be able to pull context from your apps, allowing you to, say, ask it the name of a podcast your sister recommended via text and have it presented to you without opening any separate apps or services. The idea is for Siri AI to recognize what you want, when you want it, and surface it, whether it's content on your device or from the web. It's more or less what Apple promised when it showed off its AI-enhanced Siri and Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2024. And in early demos, Siri AI, which rides on Apple Intelligence, appears to deliver on Apple's initial vision for its reimagined Siri. And it's thanks, at least in part, to Google (
GOOG
,
GOOGL
). Siri gets Google brains
In January, Apple and Google signed an agreement for Apple to use the search giant's Gemini models to power its improved Siri. That gave Apple the high-powered AI models it needed to move Siri AI forward, after its own models fell short,
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman previously reported
. During a question and answer session following Apple's WWDC keynote, senior vice president of software engineering Craig Federighi explained how Apple uses Google's models to give Siri AI its smarts. The software chief was sure to point out that Siri AI isn't just a rebranded version of Google's own Gemini assistant. Federighi explained how the Gemini assistant uses Google's Gemini models, including Gemini Flash-Lite, Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, and its Gemini Image models. When it comes to grounding those models in world knowledge, he said, Gemini takes advantage of Google Search. Apple, Federighi said, uses none of those things. "We use none of the models that Google deploys to their customers, nor do we use the infrastructure and means by which they employ models to their customers," he explained.

records.answer:
NVIDIA 在最新財報中營收同比成長 **85%**，其中資料中心營收更是 **同比上升 92%**，顯示公司正快速擴大資料中心規模；同時與 IREN 簽署的 AI 雲端合作案，透過數十億美元的合約與大量 GPU 部署，具體展現 NVIDIA 在資料中心布局上的多項進展【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #47】。

**營收成長細節**  
- 全年度營收為 **816 億美元（$81.6 billion）**，較去年同期 **上升 85%**，環比 **上升 20%**【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #47】。  
- 資料中心營收為 **752 億美元（$75.2 billion）**，較去年 **上升 92%**，環比 **上升 21%**，主要受 Blackwell 300 產品與 InfiniBand、Spectrum‑X、NVLink 需求推動【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #47】。  
- AI Clouds、Industrial & Enterprise（屬於資料中心子市場 ACIE）營收 **374 億美元（$37.4 billion）**，較去年 **上升 31%**，顯示 AI 雲端與產業客戶需求持續增長【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #47】。  

**與 IREN 合作的具體進展**  
- IREN 與 NVIDIA 簽署 **五年 34 億美元（$3.4 billion） AI Cloud 合約**，部署 Blackwell GPU，首波在 Childress 以 **60 MW** 空冷容量為起點，相關 ARR 約 **7 億美元（$700 million）**【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  
- NVIDIA 同時提供 **21 億美元（$2.1 billion） 投資**，其投資權利僅在 GPU 基礎設施部署完成後才會完全歸屬，最終目標為 **600,000 GPU** 完全部署【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  
- IREN 計畫在 2026 年建置 **480 MW AI Cloud 容量**、部署 **150,000 GPU**，並於 2027 年擴至 **1,210 MW**，其中 **300 MW** 為液冷 Childress 項目，已開始與 Microsoft、NVIDIA 交付 GPU【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 此外，IREN 已獲得 **5 GW** 已確保電力，並將 **ARR** 由 **31 億美元（$3.1 billion）** 提升至 **目標 37 億美元（$3.7 billion）**（截至 2026 年底）【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  

**反映的資料中心布局進展**  
1. **大規模 GPU 部署**：透過與 IREN 的合約，NVIDIA 將在美國 Texas Childress 及其他站點部署數十萬顆 Blackwell GPU，直接擴大其 AI 雲端算力供應。  
2. **資本投入與風險共擔**：21 億美元（$2.1 billion） 的投資與 GPU 部署掛鉤，顯示 NVIDIA 以資本方式參與資料中心建設，降低 IREN 前期資本負擔，同時確保自家 GPU 的市場滲透。  
3. **多元客戶與地理布局**：合作涵蓋 Microsoft 交付、歐洲（西班牙）與亞太（澳洲）新建站點，說明 NVIDIA 正透過合作夥伴在全球多區域擴張 AI 資料中心版圖。  
4. **收入與需求同步增長**：AI Clouds 子市場營收 YoY +31% 與 IREN 合約的 34 億美元（$3.4 billion） AI Cloud 目標相呼應，顯示 NVIDIA 的資料中心收入正受 AI 雲端需求驅動。  

綜合以上，NVIDIA 近期財報的高速營收成長與與 IREN 的大型 AI Cloud 合約，雙重證明公司正透過大量 GPU 部署、資本合作與全球化建設，快速推進資料中心版圖的擴張與多元化。

records.answer:
NVIDIA 目前的毛利率約為 **74.1%（TTM 截至 2026‑06‑12）**【NVDA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #0】。  

- **毛利率說明**：在過去十二個月內，營收 2,534.9 億美元（$253.49 billion） 產生毛利 1,879.5 億美元（$187.95 billion），計算得出毛利率 0.74144995，即 74.144995%【NVDA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #0】。  

- **中國市場的最新談話**：Jensen Huang 表示中國最終會「逐步」開放高階美國 AI 晶片的市場，尤其是 H200 這類可訓練與執行 AI 系統的晶片「將會被授權銷售」給中國【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #0】。他同時指出，Blackwell 與即將推出的 Rubin 系列仍被禁止在中國銷售，且目前尚未看到中國科技公司實際購買 H200【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #1】。  

- **潛在營收影響**：  
  1. 若中國市場真的「逐步」開放，未來 H200 以及後續更高階晶片的銷售將可能進入全球最大半導體需求市場，為 NVIDIA 帶來顯著的營收增長空間。  
  2. 目前仍無具體銷售跡象，且最高階的 Blackwell 與 Rubin 仍受禁，短期內對營收的直接貢獻可能有限。  
  3. 中國同時在加速本土晶片研發，若成功推出競爭產品，可能對 NVIDIA 的長期市場份額構成挑戰。  

綜合而言，NVIDIA 目前保持高達 74% 的毛利率，顯示其 AI 晶片的高附加價值；若中國市場如 Huang 所言「逐步」開放，高階晶片的銷售將為未來營收提供重要的增長動能，但實際影響仍取決於政策放寬的速度、競爭對手的本土化進程以及禁售產品的解除情況。

records.query: Apple 近一年的整體營收成長率是多少？加上新聞中 WWDC 發表的 Siri AI 新功能，這對公司未來的成長動能有何意義？
records.answer:
Apple 在最近一個財政年度（FY2025）相較於前一年（FY2024）的整體營收成長約 **6%**【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #155】（FY2025 營收 4,161.61 億美元（$416,161 百萬），FY2024 營收 3,910.35 億美元（$391,035 百萬））【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #0】。

**營收成長細節**  
- FY2025 營收為 4,161.61 億美元（$416,161 百萬），較 FY2024 的 3,910.35 億美元（$391,035 百萬）提升 251.26 億美元（$25,126 百萬），年增率約 6.4%（計算自表中兩年數值）【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #0】。  
- 10‑K 報表亦直接列示「Total net sales $416,161 6%」作為年度增長率【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #155】。

**WWDC 發表的 Siri AI 功能對未來成長動能的意義**  

1. **AI 能力提升與產品差異化**：Apple 在 WWDC 2026 正式推出以 Google Gemini 模型為基礎的 Siri AI，旨在讓助理能從使用者的應用程式中抓取上下文，提供更自然的對話與資訊檢索【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。此舉顯示 Apple 正在彌補自家 AI 模型不足，透過外部高階模型加速 AI 功能落地。

2. **服務收入的潛在推動**：新聞指出 Siri AI 以及 Apple Intelligence 將在 Safari、密碼與訊息等核心應用中發揮作用，預期能提升使用者黏著度，進一步刺激 App Store、廣告與 iCloud 等服務收入的成長【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。

3. **市場情緒與投資者預期**：Evercore ISI 在 2025 Q4 投資者信函中提到，AI 功能的早期採用已超出內部預期，尤其在北美與歐洲 iPhone Pro 型號的附加率仍然高企，因而將 Apple 股價目標上調至 $365，維持「Outperform」評等【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #0】。這反映投資者認為 AI 佈局將為公司帶來額外的成長動能。

4. **與競爭對手的差異化**：分析師 Gene Munster 認為 Siri AI 的推出將使 Apple 能在與 ChatGPT、Grok、Gemini 等大型語言模型的競爭中取得更好位置，並透過安全的個人化上下文提升使用者體驗【AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0】。若成功，將有助於鞏固 Apple 在高價 iPhone 及服務生態系的領先優勢。

5. **iPhone 銷售的正向回饋**：同一篇報導亦指出，過去四季 iPhone 銷售增長了 16%，而 AI 功能的整合被視為進一步提升 iPhone 吸引力的關鍵因素【AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0】。iPhone 作為 Apple 最大的營收來源，其持續成長將直接支撐整體營收的上升趨勢。

**結論**：Apple 近一年營收已達 6% 的正向成長，且 WWDC 推出的 Siri AI 透過提升 AI 能力、加強服務黏著度、提振市場情緒與鞏固 iPhone 銷售，預計將為公司未來的營收與利潤增長提供新的動能。

After two years of delays, Apple's (
AAPL
) reinvented Siri, Siri AI,
appears ready for primetime
. The company unveiled the AI-powered version of its assistant at its Worldwide Developers Conference in Cupertino, Calif., on Monday, saying it will launch, albeit as a beta, later this year. The update is designed to transform Siri from a glorified kitchen timer to a
digital helper for the AI age
. Apple said Siri AI will be able to pull context from your apps, allowing you to, say, ask it the name of a podcast your sister recommended via text and have it presented to you without opening any separate apps or services. The idea is for Siri AI to recognize what you want, when you want it, and surface it, whether it's content on your device or from the web. It's more or less what Apple promised when it showed off its AI-enhanced Siri and Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2024. And in early demos, Siri AI, which rides on Apple Intelligence, appears to deliver on Apple's initial vision for its reimagined Siri. And it's thanks, at least in part, to Google (
GOOG
,
GOOGL
). Siri gets Google brains
In January, Apple and Google signed an agreement for Apple to use the search giant's Gemini models to power its improved Siri. That gave Apple the high-powered AI models it needed to move Siri AI forward, after its own models fell short,
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman previously reported
. During a question and answer session following Apple's WWDC keynote, senior vice president of software engineering Craig Federighi explained how Apple uses Google's models to give Siri AI its smarts. The software chief was sure to point out that Siri AI isn't just a rebranded version of Google's own Gemini assistant. Federighi explained how the Gemini assistant uses Google's Gemini models, including Gemini Flash-Lite, Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, and its Gemini Image models. When it comes to grounding those models in world knowledge, he said, Gemini takes advantage of Google Search. Apple, Federighi said, uses none of those things. "We use none of the models that Google deploys to their customers, nor do we use the infrastructure and means by which they employ models to their customers," he explained.

records.query: Microsoft 的營收成長率表現如何？加上新聞中它自研七個 AI 模型的策略進展，對公司的 AI 布局透露什麼訊息？
records.answer:
Microsoft 的營收在最新財季與全年皆維持兩位數成長（約 15%‑18%），同時公司宣佈自行研發七個 AI 模型，顯示它正加速打造自有 AI 堆疊、降低對外部前沿實驗室的依賴，並把 AI 深度整合進 Azure 與 Microsoft 365 服務中。  

**營收成長率**  
- 2025 財政年度總營收 2,817.24 億美元（$281.724 billion），較 2024 年增長 15%【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143】。  
- 同年度 Microsoft Cloud 營收增長 23%，達 1,689 億美元（$168.9 billion）【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #138】。  
- 2026 年第一季（截至 2026‑03‑31）三個月營收較去年同期上升 128 億美元（$12.8 billion），成長 18%【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #102】。  
- 2026 年前三季（截至 2026‑03‑31）累計營收較去年同期上升 365 億美元（$36.5 billion），成長 18%【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #103】。  
- 同期「Productivity and Business Processes」部門營收提升 145 億美元（$14.5 billion），增幅 16%【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #109】。  

**毛利率走向**  
- 雖然營收持續成長，但毛利率百分比出現下降：Microsoft Cloud 毛利率降至 66%（2026 Q1）【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #102】；2025 全年毛利率略為下降至 69%【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143】。此下降主要因 AI 基礎設施投資與 AI 產品使用量上升所致。  

**AI 自研七模型的策略意涵**  
- Microsoft 在 2026 年 Build 大會上宣布已開發七個全新自建 AI 模型，強調「微調與成本最佳化」的方向，顯示公司正從依賴外部前沿實驗室（如 OpenAI）轉向自行打造模型【MSFT_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 為支援這些模型，Microsoft 已將大量 GPU 計算資源配置給內部研發團隊，凸顯其在 AI 基礎設施上的大規模投入【MSFT_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 同時，公司正推動「OpenClaw」的自有版本，並致力於讓使用者更容易部署 AI 代理人，說明其目標是打造完整的 DIY AI 生態系，讓 Azure、Microsoft 365 Copilot 等服務能直接受惠於自研模型的效能與成本優勢【MSFT_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。  

**綜合解讀**  
- 營收持續以兩位數成長證明 Microsoft 的雲端與生產力套件仍具強勁需求；  
- 毛利率的微幅下降反映 AI 基礎設施的大量資本支出，屬於短期成本上升的預期現象；  
- 透過自行研發七個 AI 模型並投入 GPU 計算資源，Microsoft 正在構建自有的 AI 核心能力，期望未來在 AI 服務（如 Azure AI、Copilot）上取得更高的利潤率與技術主導權，並降低對外部 AI 供應商的依賴。  

因此，營收成長與 AI 自研策略相輔相成：收入增長提供資金支撐 AI 基礎設施投資，而自研模型則為未來雲端與生產力服務的毛利率提升奠定基礎。

May 18 (Reuters) - Anthropic said on Monday it is revising its earlier position to allow users of its Mythos cybersecurity model ‌to share information about cyber threats with others who may be exposed ‌to similar vulnerabilities. Mythos, announced on April 7, is being deployed as part of Anthropic's "Project Glasswing," a controlled ​initiative under which select organizations, including major tech firms such as Amazon,
Microsoft
,
Nvidia
and
Apple
, are permitted to use the unreleased Claude Mythos Preview model for defensive cybersecurity purposes. Mythos' capabilities to code at a high level have given it a potentially ‌unprecedented ability to identify cybersecurity ⁠vulnerabilities and devise ways to exploit them, according to experts. Last week, Anthropic began telling partners that they are generally permitted to disclose ⁠their involvement in Glasswing and, at their own discretion, share findings, best practices, tools or code developed through the program. "We fully support our partners sharing findings with each ​other and ​companies outside of Glasswing to triage vulnerabilities," ​an Anthropic spokesperson said in a ‌statement. "While there was never a specific Glasswing NDA, confidentiality protections were something partners asked for at the outset and were built into agreements partners signed."
The protections were included in agreements with participating companies under which the model is provided, after partners sought assurances before sharing sensitive findings and expressed concern about being targeted by ‌attackers. "As the program has matured, we've adapted them ​to ensure key information can be shared broadly - ​including outside the program - for maximum ​defensive impact," the spokesperson added.

[MSFT] Anthropic said partners may share that ‌information with security teams at other companies, ​industry bodies, regulators and ​government agencies, open-source maintainers, the media or the public, subject to responsible-disclosure norms. The Pentagon is deploying Mythos to find and patch software vulnerabilities across ​the U.S. government even as ‌it races to complete a transition away from the AI company, the ​Defense Department's top technology official said last week. 這表示 Meta 的收入在最近 12 個月持續快速擴張，尤其在廣告收入與每則廣告平均價格提升的帶動下，營收規模已突破 200 億美元大關【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #296】。  

關於 SpaceX IPO 前的市場情況，Reuters 報導指出，對沖基金在 SpaceX 上市前拋售了包括 **Meta** 在內的「Magnificent Seven」科技股，導致這些股票自上週五以來皆出現下跌【NVDA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。  

因此，儘管 Meta 本身的營收增長強勁，但整體科技板塊的拋售情緒可能對其股價形成短期壓力，使得投資人對 Meta 的股價表現需同時考量宏觀的風險偏好變化與資金從高估值科技股流出的影響。

By Nell Mackenzie
LONDON, June 12 (Reuters) - Hedge funds sold out of the biggest U.S. tech stocks, and some even added ‌bearish positions, according to data from a JPMorgan note late ‌Thursday, just before SpaceX was set to go public on Friday. Shares in the "Magnificent Seven" -- ​a group that includes some of the biggest tech names on Wall Street, namely
Nvidia
,
Apple
, Amazon.com, Alphabet, Meta,
Tesla
, and Microsoft, have all declined since last Friday. The Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF, which tracks these ‌stocks closely, declined over 2.4% ⁠since June 5, with some analysts saying investors were clearing their decks in order to prepare for the ⁠debut of Elon Musk's Space X on Friday. SpaceX posted a net loss of $4.94 billion in 2025, but its landmark listing targets a valuation of $1.77 ​trillion ​in a record-setting IPO, which would ​make it the seventh-biggest publicly ‌traded U.S. company by market value.

China market for Nvidia AI chips to open 'over time': Huang
AFP
Tue, May 19, 2026 at 11:02 AM GMT+8
2 min read
NVDA
-1.33%
Nvidia boss Jensen Huang expects China to eventually open its market to high-end US chips that can train and run artificial intelligence systems. But he did not discuss sales of the powerful H200 model with top officials in Beijing, the businessman told Bloomberg Television in an interview broadcast Monday. Huang travelled to the country last week with US President Donald Trump, who met Chinese President Xi Jinping. The superpowers are in a fierce race for AI supremacy, and the H200 chip had until recently been barred from sale in China by Washington over national security concerns. However, there is no sign that Chinese tech companies are buying them, as Beijing ramps up domestic chip development in a bid to challenge US dominance in the key sector. "H200s are licensed to sell to China.

[NVDA] But the Chinese government has to decide how much of their local market do they want to protect," Huang said. "My sense is that over time the market will open," added Huang, CEO of Nvidia -- the world's most valuable company, due to huge demand for its AI hardware. Trump said in December he had reached an agreement with Xi to ease the restrictions on H200 chips, a move some US lawmakers have warned could help the Chinese military. records.query: NVIDIA 的核心技術護城河是什麼？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 的核心技術護城河在於其全棧加速運算平台，結合領先的 GPU、專為 AI 設計的 Tensor Core、CPU 與 DPU 硬體，以及深度整合的軟體生態系統與龐大開發者社群，形成硬體‑軟體‑服務的完整價值鏈【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】。

- **硬體領先**：NVIDIA 以 GPU 為核心，搭載自 2017 年起的 Tensor Core，並在 2023 年推出針對大規模 AI 與高效能運算的 Grace CPU，2020 年收購 Mellanox 後加入 Data Processing Unit (DPU)，形成同時支援 GPU、CPU、DPU 的三大處理單元【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】。  
- **全棧平台與軟體堆疊**：公司提供 CUDA 開發平台、CUDA‑X 加速函式庫、AI Enterprise、NVIDIA NIM、NeMo、AI Blueprints 等完整軟體套件，讓客戶能在同一平台上完成模型訓練、推論、部署與安全管理【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- **資料中心規模的共同設計**：GPU、CPU、DPU、NVLink 互連、交換晶片與系統均以「極端共設」方式整合，使數十萬顆 GPU 能夠互相連結成單一巨型電腦，滿足現代 AI 與加速運算的規模需求【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- **開發者與合作夥伴生態**：全球已有超過 750 萬名開發者使用 CUDA 及相關工具，NVIDIA 透過 Inception 計畫與數萬家新創、數百所大學合作，持續擴大生態系統的深度與廣度【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- **未來代號 Rubin 平台的成本優勢**：Rubin 平台（預計於 FY2027 下半年開始量產）針對代理式 AI 與推理工作負載，宣稱可比前代 Blackwell 下降最高 **10 倍** 的每 token 成本，進一步強化其在高效能 AI 計算上的競爭壁壘【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #25】。

以上硬體、軟體、規模化共設與廣大開發者生態的結合，構成了 NVIDIA 在加速運算與生成式 AI 市場的核心護城河。

agentic_sub_queries: Microsoft 如何把 Copilot 整合進 Microsoft 365 的產品策略？

records.query: Microsoft 如何靠 Windows 帶動雲端與 Copilot 相關服務的參與度？
records.answer:
Microsoft 透過 Windows 作為入口，結合雲端與 Copilot 服務，使使用者在作業系統上即可直接使用 AI 與雲端功能，從而提升這些服務的參與度。  

- Windows 作業系統與 Microsoft Cloud 互相整合，提供跨技術堆疊的整合、開放性、縮短價值實現時間、降低成本並提升敏捷性，讓客戶在 Windows 裝置上即能存取雲端運算與 AI 功能【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49】。  
- 在 Productivity and Business Processes 事業部中，Windows Commercial 的雲端部分被納入雲端服務收入，說明 Windows 本身即是雲端服務的組成要素之一【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  
- Microsoft 明確指出「Leveraging Windows to fuel our cloud business, … drive increased engagement with services like Microsoft Edge, Bing, Copilot, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 Consumer, Xbox Game Pass, and more」；透過 Windows 平台推動這些服務的使用，直接提升了 Copilot 及其他雲端服務的使用率【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  
- Surface 裝置（含 Copilot+ PC）被描述為「devices designed to enable people and organizations to connect using Windows and integrated Microsoft products and services」；這類 Windows 裝置讓使用者在日常工作與娛樂時即能連結至 Microsoft 365 Copilot、Edge、Bing、Teams 等雲端服務，進一步擴大服務的觸及與參與【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #57】。  

綜合上述，Microsoft 以 Windows 為核心平台，透過其在企業與消費者裝置中的廣泛部署、雲端功能的內建以及與 Copilot 等 AI 服務的深度整合，成功提升雲端與 Copilot 相關服務的使用參與度。

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS 基礎設施與 AI 領域（含與 Anthropic 的合作）的投資策略是什麼？
records.answer:
Amazon 正在加大對 AWS 基礎設施與人工智慧（AI）領域的投資，透過提升技術與基礎設施支出、擴大 AI 服務以及與 Anthropic 的股權與融資合作來支撐長期成長。[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198]  

1. **整體投資方向**  
   - Amazon 表示未來會持續增加技術與基礎設施的支出，以支援人工智慧與機器學習計畫，並透過 AWS 提供包括運算、儲存、資料庫、分析與機器學習在內的廣泛即時服務。[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198]  
   - 這些支出被視為資本支出項目，會同時支援多元產品與服務，並因地理擴張與系統跨功能性而提升規模與效率。[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198]  

2. **成本與支出趨勢**  
   - 2025 年技術與基礎設施成本較前一年上升，主要因基礎設施（包括折舊與攤銷）支出增加，外匯變動亦使成本多增 3.12 億美元（$312 million）。[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #215]  
   - 2026 年第一季（與可比前一年同期比較）技術與基礎設施成本同樣上升，主要來源仍是基礎設施支出與折舊攤銷，外匯變動使成本多增 3.74 億美元（$374 million）。[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78]  

3. **與 Anthropic 的合作與投資**  
   - 在 2026 年 3 月 31 日之後，Amazon 投資了 **50 億美元（$5.0 billion）** 於 Anthropic 的非投票優先股，以取得 AI 技術合作機會。[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40]  
   - 同時，Amazon 與 Anthropic 簽訂了可提供最高 **200 億美元（$20.0 billion）** 的融資安排，該安排在達成特定算力交付里程碑後可轉為 Anthropic 的可轉換債券或上市後的普通股；若 Amazon 行使未來股權投資選項，最多可再投資 **50 億美元（$5.0 billion）**，此金額將從可用融資額中扣除。[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40]  
   - 另外，Amazon 也修改了主要提供 AWS 雲端服務的商業協議，納入與 AWS 晶片相關的合約義務，顯示其在 AI 加速器與硬體層面的深度整合。[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40]  

4. **策略要點**  
   - **持續擴大基礎設施規模**：透過增加伺服器、網路設備與資料中心相關折舊攤銷，提升 AWS 的運算與儲存能力，以因應 AI 工作負載的成長需求。[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198]、[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78]  
   - **投資 AI 初創公司**：以股權（Anthropic 非投票優先股）與大型融資設施（最高 200 億美元（$20 billion））取得技術與產品合作權，確保 AWS 能夠提供先進的 AI 晶片與模型服務。[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40]  
   - **效率與跨功能性**：將基礎設施與技術投資視為支撐多元產品線（包括衛星寬頻、無人車等）的共同平台，藉此提升客戶體驗與營運效率。[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198]  

綜合上述，Amazon 的投資策略是透過持續加碼技術與基礎設施支出、深化 AWS AI 服務能力，並以股權與大型融資方式與 Anthropic 等前沿 AI 公司合作，確保其在雲端基礎設施與人工智慧領域保持領先與規模化成長。

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商業務上面臨哪些反壟斷或監管風險？
records.answer:
Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商平台面臨的反壟斷與監管風險，主要包括多項政府與監管機關的調查、訴訟與潛在罰款，這些風險可能導致巨額成本、營運限制或聲譽受損。  

- **競爭與反壟斷調查**：美國、加拿大與英國的州檢察長與聯邦貿易委員會（FTC）已對 Amazon 提起多起涉及價格協議、濫用市場支配地位、壟斷或企圖壟斷的訴訟，指控包括對其線上超市、Marketplace 服務與中介服務的壟斷行為，以及對定價、精選商品、賣家資料使用、廣告與 Prime 結構的反競爭做法【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #99】。  

- **AWS 雲端服務的監管風險**：Amazon 亦面臨針對其 AWS 雲端服務的競爭相關調查，指稱其在提供雲端服務時可能違反競爭或消費者保護規則【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】、【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】、【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #113】。  

- **Prime 及履行網路的調查**：調查同時涵蓋 Amazon 的實體與線上商店、履行網路（fulfillment network）以及 Prime 會員服務，指稱這些業務可能侵害競爭或消費者保護規範【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】、【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】、【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #113】。  

- **資料隱私與數據使用的監管不確定性**：除競爭問題外，Amazon 亦受到日益增長的資料收集、使用與披露相關法律與規範的審查，這些規範仍在演變中，可能導致合規成本上升或需改變業務慣例【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】、【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】、【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #114】。  

- **潛在後果**：上述調查與訴訟若導致不利裁決，Amazon 可能面臨「實質性罰款、民事或刑事責任、合規成本增加、需求或服務可得性下降、營運模式被迫改變、聲譽受損，甚至阻礙成長」等重大影響【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】、【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】、【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #114】。  

綜合以上，Amazon 在其核心的 AWS、Prime 以及整體電商業務上，正受到多層面的反壟斷與監管挑戰，涉及競爭法、消費者保護、資料隱私等領域，且相關調查與訴訟仍在持續，對公司未來的營運與財務表現構成顯著風險。

- 在搜尋方面，Gemini 3 被整合至 Google Search，提供進階的多模態理解與生成式回應，並透過 AI Overviews 讓使用者以自然語言提問，藉由 Gemini 的推理與多模態能力得到更完整的答案；AI Mode 進一步讓使用者以更細緻的問題互動，利用 Gemini 的高階推理與生成技術完成複雜查詢【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  

- 在其他產品與平台上，Alphabet 表示所有 15 個半億用戶規模的產品（其中七個產品的使用者超過二十億）皆使用 Gemini 模型，顯示 Gemini 已廣泛滲透至其核心產品線【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  

- 在 Google Cloud 服務中，Gemini 以「Gemini Enterprise」與「Gemini for Google Workspace」的形態提供企業 AI 基礎設施與協作工具，讓雲端客戶能直接使用 Gemini 的生成式與推理能力【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #71】。  

- 會議記錄中亦提到，Gemini 作為 AI 代理人可在多種情境下（例如航班預訂）結合知識與功能，展示其在終端使用者體驗中的可擴展性與即時應用【GOOGL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #1】。  

綜合以上，Google 透過在搜尋介面加入 Gemini 驅動的生成式功能、在所有大型用戶產品中全面部署 Gemini 模型，以及在雲端與企業服務中提供 Gemini 企業版與 Workspace 版，完成了 Gemini AI 在搜尋與整個產品生態系的深度整合。

Alphabet Inc. Making AI Helpful for Everyone

We believe AI is a profound platform shift that can bring meaningful and positive change to people and societies across the world, and to our business. Our technical infrastructure allows us to use and offer our customers a range of AI accelerator options, including specialized Graphics Processing Units (GPUs) and our own custom-built Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), such as Ironwood, our seventh-generation TPU. Designed to deliver advanced multimodal understanding, Gemini 3 represents our most capable iteration of agentic and generative coding technologies. Gemini 3 integrates enhanced reasoning capabilities to support visualizations and interactive user experiences across our product ecosystem, including Search and the Gemini app. As technology continues to improve rapidly, we are focused on bringing our latest AI advances to our products and platforms. •platforms, which primarily include revenues from Google Play sales of apps and in-app purchases;

•devices, which primarily include sales of the Pixel family of devices; and

•other products and services. Subscription revenues are recognized ratably over the period of the subscription, primarily monthly. records.query: Google 搜尋如何演變出 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 來回應生成式 AI 對搜尋的衝擊？
records.answer:
Google 搜尋透過加入 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode，將傳統的文字連結列表轉型為以大型語言模型（LLM）為核心的多模態、自然語言互動平台，以因應生成式 AI 對搜尋行為的衝擊【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。

- **從文字連結到多模態體驗**：Google 先前的搜尋以十個藍色連結呈現，現在已演變為「動態、多模態」的搜尋體驗，藉由 LLM 讓使用者能以更自然的語句提出問題【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  
- **AI Overviews 的功能**：AI Overviews 讓使用者「只要問 Google 任何問題，就能即時得到有幫助的回應」，相當於在搜尋結果頁面直接提供生成式 AI 的摘要或答案【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  
- **AI Mode 的功能**：AI Mode 允許使用者提出「更細緻、需要多步驟推理的問題」，這類問題過去可能需要多次搜尋才能得到答案，現在透過 Gemini 的先進推理與多模態能力一次完成【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  
- **產品開發策略**：在開發 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 時，Google 先聚焦於提升使用者體驗，再考慮後續的變現方式，並將這些 AI 功能納入搜尋與雲端企業解決方案中，以保持競爭力【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #289】。  
- **因應競爭與成本**：面對其他 AI 產品與服務開發者的激烈競爭，Google 透過持續投資技術基礎建設（如伺服器、GPU、TPU）與研發，確保 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 能在效能與成本上保持優勢，同時預期相關基礎設施成本會隨 AI 需求上升而顯著增加【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #289】。  

綜合以上，Google 搜尋以 LLM 為基礎，推出 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode，提供即時、深入且多模態的答案，直接回應生成式 AI 帶來的搜尋需求變化與市場競爭壓力。

records.query: Meta 在 AI 與 Reality Labs 上的長期願景與投資方向是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 的長期願景是打造「下一代計算平台」，透過 AI、可穿戴裝置、虛擬與增強實境等技術，將元宇宙與新型介面整合成為未來的核心生態系統【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #130】。

- **AI 投資方向**：Meta 持續加大 AI 相關基礎建設與研發，聚焦生成式 AI、超級智慧 AI 以及 AI 驅動的內容推薦與廣告工具，預期未來會持續提升此類投資規模【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68】。為支援 AI 市場的成長，Meta 於 **2025 年 10 月** 簽署與合作夥伴共同開發路易斯安那州資料中心的協議，持有 20% 的會員權益，以確保未來 AI 基礎設施的容量與彈性【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #167】。

- **Reality Labs 投資分配**：在 2026 年，Meta 計畫將 Reality Labs 營運費用的約 **70%** 用於可穿戴裝置（如 AI 眼鏡與相關硬體），其餘 **30%** 投入 VR 與 Horizon 相關項目【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。這些投資包括開發 Meta Quest 系列 VR 裝置、Passthrough 技術、AI 眼鏡（Ray‑Ban Meta、Oakley Meta）以及 AR 原型 Orion、Meta Ray‑Ban Display 與 Meta Neural Band 等新產品【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131】。

- **長期研發與市場目標**：Reality Labs 的許多投資聚焦於「長期、前沿」的研發，目標是開發尚未上市、可能在未來十年才完全實現的產品，涵蓋 AI 與硬體創新，以支援下一代介面與計算平台【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #130】。Meta 亦承認這些投資在短期內已對營運利潤造成顯著壓縮，2025 年的營運利潤因 Reality Labs 投資減少約 **191.9 億美元（$19.19 billion）**，且預期 2026 年的營運虧損將與 2025 年相似【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188】。

- **風險與不確定性**：Meta 明示若 AI 或 Reality Labs 的研發與市場接受度未如預期，可能對品牌、使用者基礎、營收與整體財務表現產生負面影響，且相關投資可能因法規、技術挑戰或競爭者的創新而面臨延遲或成本上升【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175】【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #72】。

綜合以上，Meta 的長期願景是以 AI 為核心，結合可穿戴與沉浸式硬體，透過 Reality Labs 持續投入研發與基礎設施建設，打造未來的元宇宙與新一代計算平台。

We believe the metaverse, an embodied internet where people have immersive experiences beyond two-dimensional screens, is the next evolution in social technology. In 2021, we announced a shift in our business and product strategy to focus on helping to bring the metaverse to life, and we are directing our efforts toward innovations in AI, wearables, and devices to help build next-generation interfaces. We expect this will be a complex, evolving, and long-term initiative that will involve the development of new and emerging technologies, continued investment in infrastructure as well as privacy, safety, and security efforts, and collaboration with other companies, developers, partners, and other participants. However, the metaverse may not develop in accordance with our expectations, and market acceptance of features, products, or services we build is uncertain. We regularly evaluate our product roadmaps and make significant changes as our understanding of the technological challenges and market landscape and our product ideas and designs evolve. In addition, we have relatively limited experience with consumer hardware products and virtual and augmented reality technology, which may enable other companies to compete more effectively than us. We may be unsuccessful in our research and product development efforts, including if we are unable to develop relationships with key participants in the metaverse or develop products that operate effectively with metaverse technologies, products, systems, networks, or standards. For example, some of our consumer hardware products depend on the ability to operate with third-party mobile platforms and these platforms do not necessarily provide our products with the same levels of interoperability that they provide to their own competing products. In addition, our Reality Labs efforts may also divert resources and management attention from other areas of our business. We expect to continue to make significant investments in virtual and augmented reality and other technologies to support these efforts, and our ability to support these efforts is dependent on generating sufficient profits from other areas of our business. records.query: Meta 的廣告獲利模式與 Meta AI 在旗下 App 中扮演的角色是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 主要透過在 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger 以及第三方行動應用程式上投放的印象型或行動型廣告來創造營收，廣告收入佔公司營收的絕大部分；Meta AI 則以跨 App 的智慧助理身分，協助內容排序、廣告工具、生成式 AI 體驗以及提升使用者在各平台的互動與生產力【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。

- **廣告獲利模式**  
  1. 近乎全部營收皆來自廣告，廣告收入來源於在 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger 及第三方行動應用程式上顯示的廣告產品【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】。  
  2. 廣告主依據「每千次曝光」或「使用者點擊／完成特定行動」付費，廣告收入在廣告展示或使用者完成行動的合約期間內確認【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】。  
  3. 平均每則廣告價格＝總廣告收入除以投放的廣告數量，作為衡量每則廣告平均收費的指標【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】。  
  4. 若廣告收入安排中 Meta 不是主要方，則以淨額方式確認收入【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】。  
  5. 平均每則廣告價格在 2026 年第一季較去年同期上升 12%【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #216】。  
  6. 廣告收入受限於廣告定位與測量工具的資料訊號（包括網站、服務以及自家產品的使用者活動資料）以及歐盟 GDPR、ePrivacy、Digital Services Act、Digital Markets Act 及美國州隱私法等法規限制，導致行銷支出下降的風險【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #216】。

- **Meta AI 在旗下 App 中的角色**  
  1. Meta AI 是一個跨平台的智慧助理，除了在 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger 等 App 中內嵌外，亦提供獨立 App、AI 眼鏡與網路版，協助使用者學習、完成任務、創作內容並與他人連結【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
  2. Meta AI 內嵌於「Family of Apps」事業部，與其他 FoA 產品共同提供服務【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。  
  3. AI 投資支援多項功能，包括：為應用程式內的內容排序、驅動推薦引擎、提供廣告主的投放工具、開發生成式 AI 體驗，以及提升產品開發與生產效率【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
  4. 透過這些 AI 能力，Meta 能在廣告投放、內容發現與使用者互動上提供更相關且有效的體驗，間接增強廣告收入的價值【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。

records.query: Tesla 如何把自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術當作與競爭對手的核心差異化？
records.answer:
Tesla 把自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術作為與競爭對手的核心差異化，主要透過以下四個面向：

1. **全車系皆為自動駕駛設計**：Tesla 表示「每一台今天交付的 Tesla 車輛皆為設計為自動駕駛」且藉由 AI 讓這些功能持續進化，讓產品在安全與便利性上與其他品牌形成明顯區隔【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31】。  

2. **自研視覺與推論晶片**：公司使用「自家設計的推論晶片」加速視覺‑基礎的神經網路訓練與執行，這是內部開發的 AI 硬體基礎設施，與依賴外部供應商的競爭者形成技術壁壘【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31】。  

3. **OTA（Over‑the‑Air）軟體持續更新**：Tesla 透過「空中軟體更新」不斷提升自動駕駛功能與車輛安全，讓車主在不必回廠的情況下即能取得最新的 AI 演算法與功能，這在業界屬於獨特的服務模式【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31】。  

4. **結合 FSD 訂閱與 Robotaxi 服務的商業模式**：公司已於 2025 年 6 月推出 Robotaxi，並以 FSD（Supervised）訂閱作為收入來源，藉此打造「以 AI、軟體與車隊為基礎的服務驅動」商業模型，與傳統叫車平台及其他電動車製造商形成差異【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31】。  

此外，Tesla 也在多個層面強調其 **垂直整合、品牌與使用者體驗** 以及 **AI 研發專長**，認為這些因素共同構成相較於其他汽車與 AI 競爭者的競爭優勢【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #30】。在面對 AI 與機器人領域的競爭時，Tesla 仍以「價格、能源密度、效率、最佳化與效能」等產品規格為競爭點，但其核心差異化仍聚焦於上述的 AI 自主駕駛技術與服務化布局【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51】。  

總結來說，Tesla 透過全車系自動駕駛設計、自研推論晶片、OTA 軟體持續升級，以及結合 FSD 訂閱與 Robotaxi 的服務模式，將自動駕駛技術打造為與競爭對手最重要的差異化核心。

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] We have planned electric vehicles to address additional vehicle markets, and will continue leveraging developments in our proprietary Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) features, battery cell and other technologies. For purposes of this filing, use of the term “FSD (Supervised)” includes the equivalent naming convention, “FSD (Capability)” that is used in the European, Middle East and Asia-Pacific regions. In June 2025, we launched our Robotaxi service, an autonomous ride-hailing platform that harnesses our technology and vehicles. We expect this service will open access to an expanded customer base as modes of transportation evolve, and, along with products such as FSD (Supervised) subscriptions, unlock the potential to advance a service-driven business model based on AI, software and fleet-based profits. Our Robotaxi business currently operates with Model Y vehicles but, in time, will include Cybercab, our purpose-built autonomous vehicle. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Products

Powerwall and Megapack are our lithium-ion battery energy storage products. Powerwall, which we sell and lease to customers, as well as through channel partners, is designed to store energy at homes or small commercial facilities. Megapack is an energy storage solution for commercial, industrial, utility and energy generation customers, multiple of which may be grouped together to form larger installations of gigawatt hours (“GWh”) or greater capacity. As AI infrastructure drives rapid load growth, Megapack helps to, among other things, increase utilization of existing generation and transmission capacity, resulting in a more efficient use of the electric grid. We also continue to develop software capabilities for remotely controlling and dispatching our energy storage systems across a wide range of markets and applications, including through our real-time energy control and optimization platforms for Megapack batteries (Autobidder) and distributed energy resources like Powerwall (Powerhub). Energy Generation Offerings

We sell energy generation systems directly to customers and also through channel partners. We design and manufacture certain components for our energy generation products, including solar panels and Solar Roof, which combines premium glass roof tiles with energy generation. We also purchase many components for our energy generation systems from various third-party manufacturers to provide for competitive pricing and adequate supply. Technology

Automotive

Self-Driving Development and Artificial Intelligence 

We use AI to develop real-world applications, such as autonomous driving solutions and robots. We utilize vision-based technologies, systems and software to train our artificial neural networks, which are accelerated by our own in-house, custom designed inference chips. We are also applying our artificial intelligence learnings from self-driving technology to Bots, such as Optimus, a general purpose, autonomous humanoid robot in development. Currently, we offer in our customer vehicles certain advanced driver assistance systems. Although at present, same as in the past, the driver is responsible for remaining fully engaged in the driving operation, these systems provide safety and convenience functionality that may relieve drivers of many tedious and potentially dangerous aspects of road travel much like the system that airplane pilots use, when conditions permit. As with other vehicle systems, we improve these functions in our customer vehicles through over-the-air software updates. Every Tesla vehicle delivered today is designed for autonomy, and we believe our capabilities and advancements in AI differentiate us from our competitors. Vehicle Control and Infotainment Software

The performance and safety systems of our vehicles and their battery packs utilize sophisticated control software. Control systems in our vehicles optimize performance, customize vehicle behavior, manage charging and control all infotainment functions. We develop almost all of this software, including most of the user interfaces, internally and update our vehicles’ software regularly through over-the-air updates, and work to actively improve our software security with every release. Battery and Powertrain

Our core vehicle technology competencies include powertrain engineering and manufacturing and our ability to design vehicles that utilize the unique advantages of an electric powertrain. We have designed our proprietary powertrain systems to be adaptable, efficient, reliable and cost-effective while withstanding the rigors of an automotive environment. We offer dual motor powertrain vehicles, which use two electric motors to maximize traction and performance in an all-wheel drive configuration, as well as vehicle powertrain technology featuring three electric motors for further increased performance in certain versions of Model S and Model X, Cybertruck and the Tesla Semi. We maintain extensive testing and R&D capabilities for battery cells, packs and systems, and have built an expansive body of knowledge on lithium-ion cell chemistry types and performance characteristics.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] As we seek to become a top provider of autonomous solutions, we also face competition in the fields of AI and robotics. We expect our Robotaxi service to compete in this developing market, along with traditional ride-hailing and taxi services, through continued progress on our FSD (Supervised) and neural network capabilities, Supercharger network and infotainment offerings. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Systems

The market for energy storage products and services is also highly competitive, and both established and emerging companies have introduced products and services that are similar to our product portfolio or that are alternatives to the elements of our systems or software service offerings. We compete with these companies based on price, energy density, efficiency, optimization and performance. We believe that the specifications and features of our products, our strong brand and the modular, scalable nature of our energy storage products give us a competitive advantage in our markets. 10


Energy Generation Systems

The primary competitors to our energy generation business are the traditional local utility companies that supply energy to our potential customers. We compete with these traditional utility companies primarily based on price and the ease by which customers can switch to electricity generated by our energy generation systems. We also compete with solar energy companies that provide products and services similar to ours. Many solar energy companies only install solar energy systems, while others only provide financing for these installations. We believe we have a significant expansion opportunity with our offerings, including in terms of the aesthetics, superior performance and ease of installation and integration with Powerwall of our solar panels, and that the environment is increasingly conducive to the adoption of renewable energy systems. Intellectual Property

We place a strong emphasis on our innovative approach and proprietary designs which bring intrinsic value and uniqueness to our product portfolio. As part of our business, we seek to protect the underlying intellectual property rights of these innovations and designs such as with respect to patents, trademarks, copyrights, trade secrets, confidential information and other measures, including through employee and third-party nondisclosure agreements and other contractual arrangements. For example, we place a high priority on obtaining patents to provide the broadest and strongest possible protection to enable our freedom to operate our innovations and designs across all of our products and technologies as well as to protect and defend our product portfolio. We have also adopted a patent policy in which we irrevocably pledged that we will not initiate a lawsuit against any party for infringing our patents through activity relating to electric vehicles or related equipment for so long as such party is acting in good faith. We made this pledge in order to encourage the advancement of a common, rapidly-evolving platform for electric vehicles, thereby benefiting ourselves, other companies making electric vehicles and the world. Human Capital Resources 

Tesla’s ability to attract, develop and retain a talented workforce is a competitive advantage. As of December 31, 2025, our employee headcount worldwide was 134,785.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] ITEM 1. BUSINESS

Overview

We are focused on bringing artificial intelligence (“AI”) into the real world, through products and services like Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) and Robotaxi, as well as working to develop and commercialize AI robots (“Bots”) (including Optimus). We intend to leverage our current operations, in which we design, develop, manufacture, sell and lease high-performance fully electric vehicles and energy generation and storage systems that increasingly deliver AI-related and enhanced software and services to our customers, to achieve that objective. We generally sell our products directly to customers, and continue to grow our global retail, service and charging footprint to accelerate the widespread adoption of our products. We emphasize performance, attractive styling and the safety of our users and workforce in the design and manufacture of our products and are continuing to develop full self-driving technology for improved safety. We also strive to lower the cost of ownership for our customers through continuous efforts to reduce manufacturing costs and by offering financial and other services tailored to our products. Our mission is building a world of amazing abundance. We believe that this mission, along with our engineering expertise, advancements in real-world AI, vertically integrated business model, and focus on user experience differentiate us from other companies. Segment Information

We operate as two reportable segments: (i) automotive and (ii) energy generation and storage. The automotive segment includes the design, development, manufacturing, sales and leasing of high-performance fully electric vehicles as well as sales of automotive regulatory credits. Additionally, the automotive segment also includes services and other, which includes sales of used vehicles, non-warranty maintenance services and collision, paid Supercharging sessions, automotive insurance business revenue, part sales and retail merchandise sales. The energy generation and storage segment includes sales, leasing, and financing of energy generation and storage products, services related to such products and sales of energy generation incentives. Our Products and Services

Automotive

We currently manufacture five different consumer vehicles – the Model 3, Y, S, X and Cybertruck. Model 3 is a four-door mid-size sedan that we designed for manufacturability with a base price for mass-market appeal. Model Y is a compact sport utility vehicle (“SUV”) built on the Model 3 platform with seating for up to seven adults. Model S is a four-door full-size sedan and Model X is a mid-size SUV with seating for up to seven adults. Model S and Model X feature the highest performance characteristics and longest ranges that we offer in a sedan and SUV, respectively. The Cybertruck is a full-size electric pickup truck with a stainless steel exterior that has the utility and strength of a truck while featuring the speed of a sports car. In 2022, we also began early production and deliveries of a commercial electric vehicle, the Tesla Semi.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] Our cost reduction efforts, cost innovation strategies, and additional localized procurement and manufacturing are key to our vehicles’ affordability and have allowed us to competitively price our vehicles. We will also continue to generate demand by improving our vehicles’ performance and functionality, including through product offerings and features utilizing artificial intelligence such as FSD (Supervised) and other software, and delivering new vehicles and vehicle options. In addition, we believe the launch of our Robotaxi service unlocks the potential for significant business growth to advance a service-driven business model. We will continue to improve safety and profitability while scaling the network. In addition, we have been increasing awareness, and expanding our vehicle financing programs, including attractive leasing terms for our customers. We will also continue to work on developing our robotics offerings. However, we operate in a cyclical industry that is sensitive to shifting consumer trends, political and regulatory uncertainty, including with respect to trade and the environment, all of which can be compounded by inflationary pressures, rising energy prices, interest rate fluctuations and the liquidity of enterprise customers. For example, as inflationary pressures increased across the markets in which we operate, central banks in developed countries raised interest rates rapidly and substantially, which impacted the affordability of vehicle lease and finance arrangements. Further, sales of vehicles in the automotive industry also tend to be cyclical in many markets, which may expose us to increased volatility as we expand and adjust our operations. Moreover, as additional competitors enter the marketplace and help bring the world closer to sustainable transportation, we will have to adjust and continue to execute well to maintain our momentum. Additionally, our suppliers’ liquidity and allocation plans may be affected by current challenges in the automotive industry, which could reduce our access to components or result in unfavorable changes to cost. These macroeconomic and industry trends have had, and will likely continue to have, an impact on the pricing of, and order rate for our vehicles, and in turn our operating margin. Changes in government and economic policies, incentives or tariffs may also impact our production, cost structure and the competitive landscape. For instance, while the final scope and application of recently announced changes in trade policy remain uncertain at this time, higher tariffs on imports and subsequent retaliatory tariffs could adversely impact consumer spending and demand for durable goods and related services. Furthermore, certain provisions of the OBBBA, including the removal of tax credits for electric vehicles, may also impact consumer demand for electric vehicles in general. We will continue to adjust accordingly to such developments, and we believe our ongoing cost reduction efforts, including through production innovation, process improvements and logistics optimization, and focus on operating leverage, vertical integration and supply chain localization will continue to benefit us in relation to our competitors. Our new products and our advances in autonomy and robotics, position us for future growth. 32

records.query: Tesla 在電動車市場面臨什麼樣的競爭態勢？
records.answer:
Tesla 在全球電動車市場面臨「高度且日益加劇」的競爭，來自既有大型汽車廠、快速崛起的新進廠商，以及同時投入自動駕駛與能源業務的多元對手【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66】。

- 競爭對手不僅包括傳統內燃機車廠，還有大量已推出或計畫推出電動、混合動力、插電式混合以及全電動車型的既有與新興汽車製造商【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #50】。  
- 這些廠商同時在自動駕駛技術與車載軟體平台上投入資源，使得自動駕駛解決方案的市場需求若未如預期，將直接影響 Tesla 的營運與財務表現【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66】。  
- 政府與經濟激勵措施（例如本土組裝或本地供應鏈優惠）可能使競爭對手獲得更大利益，進一步削弱 Tesla 的獲利能力【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66】。  
- 許多競爭者擁有「更充足或更成熟的資源」來支援產品設計、開發、生產、分銷、行銷與售後服務，且因地理與成本結構優勢可取得額外的成本效率，這可能導致 Tesla 的車輛單位銷量下降、價格被迫下調、營收缺口、客戶流失與市場佔有率下降【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66】。  
- 在能源產生與儲能業務方面，Tesla 亦面臨來自其他製造商、開發商、安裝商與大型公用事業公司的激烈競爭，且若電力零售或批發價格下降，亦可能削弱其產品的吸引力，增加客戶違約風險【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66】。  
- 此外，Tesla 正在開發機器人（Bots）如 Optimus，屬於尚未成熟的產業，亦面臨來自其他公司在機器人設計、開發與製造上的激烈競爭，若該業務未如預期成長，亦會對公司整體表現產生負面影響【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66】。

records.query: Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務在公司整體策略中扮演什麼角色？
records.answer:
Tesla 把能源生成與儲能業務定位為公司長期成長機會的關鍵業務之一，並透過技術協同與產品整合來支援整體策略【TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。

- 這項業務屬於「Energy Generation and Storage」分部，與汽車部門平行，提供住宅、商業與工業客戶的太陽能板、Solar Roof、Powerwall、Megapack 等產品【TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 能源儲存產品利用來自車輛的電池模組化設計與電力電子技術，並結合 AI 軟體平台 Powerhub（分散式能源資源）與 Autobidder（Megapack）進行遠端控制與最佳化【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32】。  
- 能源生成系統（新住宅翻新太陽能板、Solar Roof）同樣採用自家太陽能逆變器與 Powerwall 整合，顯示產品間的高度互補性【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32】。  
- 2025 年公司部署了 46.7 GWh 的能源儲能產品，顯示此業務的規模與成長動能【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #115】。  
- 雖然當前關稅政策對能源生成與儲能業務的成本影響較汽車業務大，Tesla 仍將其視為長期成長機會，並在風險管理下持續投資相關技術與產能【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #115】。  
- 為支援清潔能源與交通事業，Tesla 正在擴建 AI 訓練叢集（Cortex、Cortex 2）與與 Samsung 合作製造 AI 推論晶片，這些基礎建設同時提升能源儲能與生成產品的智慧化與效能【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32】。  

綜合上述，能源生成與儲能不僅是獨立的產品線，還透過共享車用電池與 AI 軟體、垂直整合供應鏈與基礎建設投資，成為 Tesla 整體策略中支撐長期獲利與多元化收入的重要組成部分。

records.query: Apple 自己在 10-K 中如何描述它在智慧型手機、PC、平板市場面臨的競爭壓力與市佔地位？
records.answer:
Apple 在 2025 年 10‑K 中說明，它在智慧型手機、個人電腦、平板與穿戴裝置等主要市場僅佔「少數」市場份額，且必須面對資源充沛、價格激進且不斷模仿其產品與服務的競爭者所帶來的強大壓力【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。

- **市場佔有率**：文件明確指出 Apple 在全球智慧型手機、個人電腦、平板與穿戴裝置市場皆屬「少數」市場佔有者，這會使開發者較不願投入資源於 Apple 平台，進一步影響產品需求【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】；同樣的說法亦在討論第三方開發者依賴時再次提及其「少數」市場份額【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。

- **競爭壓力的來源**  
  1. **技術與資源優勢**：競爭者擁有「顯著的技術、行銷、分銷與其他資源」，以及既有的硬體、軟體與服務生態系，能以大規模客戶基礎對抗 Apple【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  
  2. **價格競爭**：許多競爭者採取「激進的降價」策略，甚至以「幾乎無利潤或虧損」的價格提供產品，對 Apple 造成毛利率向下的壓力【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  
  3. **模仿與整合**：競爭者不斷「模仿 Apple 的產品特性與應用」以及「將組件無縫整合於自家產品」或與其他公司合作提供整合解決方案，令競爭環境持續加劇【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  
  4. **價格與毛利率下行**：市場特徵包括「激進的價格競爭」與「毛利率向下的壓力」，且產品生命週期短、技術標準快速演變，進一步提升了競爭強度【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #23】。  
  5. **規模與成本結構**：部分競爭者具備「廣泛的產品線、低價產品、大量已安裝設備」以及「低成本結構」，使其能以極低價格甚至虧損的方式參與市場【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。

The Company’s future performance depends in part on support from third-party software developers. The Company believes decisions by customers to purchase its hardware products depend in part on the availability of third-party software applications and services. Third-party developers may discontinue the development and maintenance of software applications and services for the Company’s products. If third-party software applications and services cease to be developed and maintained for the Company’s products, customers may choose not to buy the Company’s products, adversely impacting the Company’s business, results of operations, financial condition and stock price. The Company believes that third-party developer support depends on the perceived benefits of creating software and services for the Company’s products compared to competitors’ platforms, such as Android for smartphones and tablets, Windows for personal computers and tablets, and PlayStation, Nintendo and Xbox for gaming platforms. This analysis may be based on factors such as the market position of the Company and its products, the anticipated revenue that may be generated, expected future growth of product sales, and the costs of developing such applications and services. The Company’s minority market share in the global smartphone, personal computer, tablet and wearables markets can make developers less inclined to develop or upgrade software for the Company’s products and more inclined to devote their resources to developing and upgrading software for competitors’ products with larger market share. When developers focus their efforts on these competing platforms, the availability and quality of applications for the Company’s devices can suffer. The Company relies on the continued availability and development of compelling and innovative software applications for its products. The Company’s products and operating systems are subject to rapid technological change, and when third-party developers are unable to or choose not to keep up with this pace of change, their applications can fail to take advantage of these changes to deliver improved customer experiences, can operate incorrectly, and can result in dissatisfied customers and lower customer demand for the Company’s products. Failure to obtain or create digital content that appeals to the Company’s customers, or to make such content available on commercially reasonable terms, could have a material adverse impact on the Company’s business, results of operations and financial condition. The Company contracts with numerous third parties to offer their digital content to customers. This includes the right to sell, or offer subscriptions to, third-party content, as well as the right to incorporate specific content into the Company’s own services. The licensing or other distribution arrangements for this content can be for relatively short time periods and do not guarantee the continuation or renewal of these arrangements on commercially reasonable terms, or at all. Some third-party content providers and distributors currently or in the future may offer competing products and services, and can take actions to make it difficult or impossible for the Company to license or otherwise distribute their content. Other content owners, providers or distributors may seek to limit the Company’s access to, or increase the cost of, such content. The Company may be unable to continue to offer a wide variety of content at commercially reasonable prices with acceptable usage rules. The Company also produces its own digital content, which can be costly to produce due to intense and increasing competition for talent, content and subscribers, and may fail to appeal to the Company’s customers. The Company’s success depends largely on the talents and efforts of its team members, the continued service and availability of highly skilled employees, including key personnel, and the Company’s ability to nurture its distinctive and inclusive culture. Much of the Company’s future success depends on the talents and efforts of its team members and the continued availability and service of key personnel, including its Chief Executive Officer, executive team and other highly skilled employees. Experienced personnel in the technology industry are in high demand and competition for their talents is intense, especially in Silicon Valley, where most of the Company’s key personnel are located. Periods of intense competition for talent in particular fields can lead to increased costs as the Company seeks to offer competitive compensation to recruit and retain highly skilled employees.
agentic_sub_queries: Apple 在 10-K 中如何描述它在智慧型手機、PC、平板市場的競爭壓力與市佔地位？

records.query: Apple 的第三方開發者生態系相對於 Android、Windows 等平台的黏著度是如何建立的？
records.answer:
Apple 透過 App Store 直接把第三方應用交付給高價值的 iOS 用戶，並以硬體、軟體與服務的深度整合提升開發者對平台的黏著度【Reference 6, chunk #3】。

- Apple 的未來表現部分仰賴第三方軟體開發者的支援，開發者是否持續投入取決於相較於 Android（手機與平板）與 Windows（個人電腦）等競爭平台的收益預期、成長機會與開發成本等因素【Reference 5, chunk #110】。  
- 因為 Apple 在全球智慧手機、個人電腦、平板與穿戴裝置的市場佔有率較低，開發者可能較不願意投入資源於此平台，而更傾向於使用市場規模較大的 Android 與 Windows 生態系【Reference 5, chunk #110】。  
- 為了提升開發者黏著度，Apple 以 App Store 作為統一的應用上架、付費與行銷渠道，提供嚴格審核、穩定的分發機制以及高品質的使用者體驗，吸引開發者將產品放在 iOS 生態系統中【Reference 6, chunk #3】。  
- Apple 亦藉由硬體（iPhone、iPad、Mac、Apple Watch）與服務（iCloud、Apple Music、Apple TV+）的緊密結合，讓開發者能跨平台開發並獲得更高的使用者留存率，進一步加強對 iOS 平台的依賴【Reference 5, chunk #110】。  
- 同時，Apple 投入大量資源於人才招募與內容創作，以確保持續提供創新功能與開發工具，這些舉措都有助於鞏固第三方開發者在 Apple 生態系的黏著度【Reference 5, chunk #110】。

[MSFT 10-K period 2025] Individual consumers obtain these products primarily through retail outlets. We distribute our devices through third-party retailers. We have a network of field sales representatives and field support personnel that solicit orders from distributors and resellers and provide product training and sales support. Our Dynamics business solutions are also licensed to enterprises through a global network of channel partners providing vertical solutions and specialized services. OEMs 

We distribute our products and services through OEMs that pre-install our software on new devices and servers they sell. The largest component of the OEM business is the Windows operating system pre-installed on devices. OEMs also sell devices pre-installed with other Microsoft products and services, including applications such as Office and the capability to subscribe to Microsoft 365 Consumer. There are two broad categories of OEMs. The largest category of OEMs are direct OEMs as our relationship with them is managed through a direct agreement between Microsoft and the OEM. We have distribution agreements covering one or more of our products with virtually all the multinational OEMs, including Dell, Hewlett-Packard, Lenovo, and with many regional and local OEMs. The second broad category of OEMs are system builders consisting of lower-volume PC manufacturers, which source Microsoft software for pre-installation and local redistribution primarily through the Microsoft distributor channel rather than through a direct agreement or relationship with Microsoft. LICENSING OPTIONS 

We offer options for organizations of varying sizes that want to purchase our cloud services and on-premises software. We license these organizations under volume licensing agreements to allow the customer to acquire multiple licenses of products and services instead of having to acquire separate licenses through retail channels. These volume licensing programs have varying programmatic requirements and benefits to best meet the needs of our customers. Software Assurance (“SA”) conveys rights to new software and upgrades for perpetual licenses released over the contract period. It also provides support, tools, training, and other licensing benefits to help customers deploy and use software efficiently. SA is required to be purchased with certain volume licensing agreements and is an optional purchase with others. Volume Licensing Programs

Enterprise Agreement 

Enterprise Agreements offer large organizations a manageable volume licensing program that gives them the flexibility to buy cloud services and software licenses under one agreement. Enterprise Agreements are designed for medium or large organizations that want to license Microsoft products and services organization-wide over a three-year period. Organizations can elect to purchase perpetual licenses (covered with SA) and/or subscribe to cloud services. Microsoft Customer Agreement

Microsoft Customer Agreements are simplified purchase agreements presented, accepted, and stored through a digital experience. Microsoft Customer Agreements are non-expiring agreements that are designed to support all customers over time, whether purchasing through a partner or directly from Microsoft. Microsoft Online Subscription Agreement

Microsoft Online Subscription Agreements are designed for small and medium organizations that want to subscribe to, activate, provision, and maintain cloud services seamlessly and directly via the web. These agreements allow customers to acquire monthly or annual subscriptions for cloud-based services. Microsoft Products and Services Agreement 

Microsoft Products and Services Agreements are designed for medium and large organizations that want to license cloud services and on-premises software as needed, with no organization-wide commitment, under a single, non-expiring agreement. Organizations purchase perpetual licenses or subscribe to licenses. SA is optional for customers that purchase perpetual licenses. Open Value

Open Value agreements are a simple, cost-effective way to acquire the latest Microsoft technology. These agreements are designed for small and medium organizations that want to license cloud services and on-premises software over a three-year period. Under Open Value agreements, organizations can elect to purchase perpetual licenses or subscribe to licenses and SA is included. Select Plus 

A Select Plus agreement is designed for government and academic organizations to acquire on-premises licenses at any affiliate or department level, while realizing advantages as one organization. Organizations purchase perpetual licenses and SA is optional. Partner Programs 

The Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider Program offers customers an easy way to license the cloud services they need in combination with the value-added services offered by their systems integrator, managed services provider, or cloud reseller partner. Partners in this program can easily package their own products and services to directly provision, manage, and support their customer subscriptions. The Microsoft Services Provider License Agreement allows hosting service providers and independent software vendors who want to license eligible Microsoft software products to provide hosted applications and software services to their end customers. Partners license software over a three-year period and are billed monthly based on units licensed. The Independent Software Vendor Royalty Program enables partners to integrate Microsoft products into other applications and then license the unified business solution to their end users. GOVERNMENT REGULATION 

We are subject to a wide range of laws, regulations, and legal requirements in the U.S.

If third-party software applications and services cease to be developed and maintained for the Company’s products, customers may choose not to buy the Company’s products, adversely impacting the Company’s business, results of operations, financial condition and stock price. The Company believes that third-party developer support depends on the perceived benefits of creating software and services for the Company’s products compared to competitors’ platforms, such as Android for smartphones and tablets, Windows for personal computers and tablets, and PlayStation, Nintendo and Xbox for gaming platforms. This analysis may be based on factors such as the market position of the Company and its products, the anticipated revenue that may be generated, expected future growth of product sales, and the costs of developing such applications and services. The Company’s minority market share in the global smartphone, personal computer, tablet and wearables markets can make developers less inclined to develop or upgrade software for the Company’s products and more inclined to devote their resources to developing and upgrading software for competitors’ products with larger market share. When developers focus their efforts on these competing platforms, the availability and quality of applications for the Company’s devices can suffer. The Company relies on the continued availability and development of compelling and innovative software applications for its products. The Company’s products and operating systems are subject to rapid technological change, and when third-party developers are unable to or choose not to keep up with this pace of change, their applications can fail to take advantage of these changes to deliver improved customer experiences, can operate incorrectly, and can result in dissatisfied customers and lower customer demand for the Company’s products. [AAPL] The Board authorized another $100 billion buyback and raised the dividend 4%. Search volume from financial pros spiked, with Apple drawing nearly 21,000 searches in the past month, per our TrackStar data, more than its next four hardware peers combined. So is the run sustainable, or did Apple just front-load demand ahead of more tariff drama? Apple’s Business
Apple needs no introduction, but the company’s transformation does. What was once a hardware story is now a hybrid: $80.2 billion in product sales last quarter alongside $31.0 billion in high-margin services. The installed base of active devices hit another all-time high across every product category and every geography. Apple sells iPhones, Macs, iPads, wearables, and a growing suite of subscription services to roughly a billion paying users globally. Apple segments its business into the following areas:
iPhone (51% of total revenues)
– Flagship smartphone line, recently expanded with the iPhone 17 lineup and a new iPhone 17e
Services (28% of total revenues)
– App Store, advertising, iCloud, Apple Music, Apple TV+, and payment services
Mac (8% of total revenues)
– Laptops and desktops, including the newly launched MacBook Neo
Wearables, Home & Accessories (7% of total revenues)
– AirPods, Apple Watch, Vision Pro, and accessories
iPad (6% of total revenues)
– Tablet lineup, recently refreshed with the M4-powered iPad Air
iPhone revenue jumped 22% to $57.0 billion, the standout of the quarter. Services climbed 16% to a record $31.0 billion, propelled by advertising, App Store, and cloud. On the strategic front, Apple is going all-in on AI infrastructure. R&D spending jumped 34% year-over-year to $11.4 billion last quarter, citing higher infrastructure costs. [NVDA 10-Q period 202604] In August 2022, the USG announced export restrictions and export licensing requirements targeting China’s semiconductor and supercomputing industries. These restrictions impacted exports of certain chips, as well as software, hardware, equipment and technology used to develop, produce and manufacture certain chips to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and Russia, and specifically impact our A100 and H100 integrated circuits, DGX or any other systems or boards which incorporate A100 or H100 integrated circuits. In July 2023, the USG also informed us of an additional licensing requirement for a subset of A100 and H100 products destined to certain customers and other regions, including some countries in the Middle East. In October 2023, the USG announced new and updated licensing requirements for exports to China and Country Groups D:1, D:4, and D:5 (including but not limited to, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Vietnam, but excluding Israel) of our products exceeding certain performance thresholds, including, but not limited to, the A100, A800, H100, H800, L4, L40, L40S RTX 4090, GB200 NVL72, and B200. The licensing requirements also apply to the export of products exceeding certain performance thresholds to a party headquartered in, or with an ultimate parent headquartered in, Country Group D5, including China. In April 2025, the USG informed us that it requires a license for export to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and D:5 countries, or to companies headquartered or with an ultimate parent therein, of our H20 integrated circuits and any other circuits achieving the H20’s memory bandwidth, interconnect bandwidth, or combination thereof. As a result of these requirements, we incurred a $4.5 billion charge in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026 associated with H20 for excess inventory and purchase obligations, as the demand for H20 products diminished. Beginning in August 2025, the USG granted licenses that would allow us to ship certain H20 products to certain China-based customers. USG officials expressed an expectation that the USG will receive 15% or more of the revenue generated from licensed sales of our products, but the USG did not publish a regulation codifying such requirement. Beginning in February 2026, the USG granted licenses that would allow us to ship small amounts of H200 products to specific China-based customers. To date, we have not generated any revenue under the H200 licensing program, and do not yet know whether any imports will be allowed into China. The license requires that the H200s go through an inspection process in the United States prior to any shipment to the customer. As a result, any H200 shipped under the new licensing program will be subject to a 25% tariff upon importation into the United States. In the event that we are able to sell licensed products into the China market, we may not be able to pass along all or any of the tariff to our customers, and may be subject to litigation, increased costs, and a harmed competitive position. The export controls applicable to China are complex and address a variety of parameters, including the total processing performance of a chip, the “performance density” of a chip, the interconnect bandwidth of a chip, and the memory bandwidth of a chip. Under the current rules and geopolitical landscape, we are unable to create and deliver a competitive product for China’s data center market that receives approval from both the USG and the Chinese government. As of the end of the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, while we were able to ship uncontrolled products to China, such as gaming and workstation GPUs, we were effectively foreclosed from competing in China's data center computing/compute market, and our effective foreclosure from the China market helped our competitors build larger developer and customer ecosystems to challenge us worldwide. Unless we are able to return with a data center system that meets the approval of both the USG and the Chinese government, our lost opportunity and the benefit to our competitors will have a material and adverse impact on our business, operating results, and financial condition.

records.query: 為什麼大家做 AI 都要靠 NVIDIA 的技術，別家學不來？
records.answer:
AI 之所以幾乎必須依賴 NVIDIA 的技術，是因為它提供了從硬體到軟體、從晶片到生態系統的完整端到端加速平台，且已被全球絕大多數超級電腦與上千萬開發者廣泛採用。  

- NVIDIA 以 **GPU、CPU、DPU** 為核心，結合高速互連（NVLink、InfiniBand、Ethernet）與完整的軟體堆疊（SDK、API、庫、框架）形成全套 **AI 加速計算平台**，同時支援訓練與推論工作負載【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- 這套平台在 2026 年的 10‑K 中被明確描述為 **「完整、端到端的加速計算平台」**，涵蓋資料中心規模的運算、網路、系統與軟體，並將 GPU、CPU、DPU 三大處理單元整合於 AI 伺服器【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- NVIDIA 透過 **NVIDIA AI Enterprise**（含 NIM、NeMo、AI Blueprints）簡化企業級生成式 AI 應用的開發與部署，提供產業領先的模型與資料集支援【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- 其 **CUDA** 開發平台與其他軟體工具已吸引 **超過 750 萬名全球開發者** 使用，形成龐大且持續擴張的生態系統【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- NVIDIA 以 **Blackwell 架構** 為核心，支援「數十萬」GPU 互聯成單一巨型電腦，實現資料中心規模的 AI 基礎建設，這種極端共設計的硬體‑軟體整合在業界難以複製【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- 在 2026 年的 10‑K 中，Compute & Networking 事業部明確列出 **GPU、CPU、DPU** 以及相關軟體與服務，說明 NVIDIA 在 AI 基礎設施的全堆疊領導地位【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24】。  
- NVIDIA 的平台已 **支援 78% 以上的 TOP500 超級電腦**，且在 Green500 前十名中佔有 **9 台**，顯示其在高效能運算與 AI 訓練領域的市場支配力【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #22】。  
- 公司的 **Deep Learning Institute**、與全球 **大學、上千家新創** 的合作（Inception 計畫）持續培育 AI 人才與技術創新，進一步鞏固其生態系統壁壘【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- 由於 NVIDIA 同時提供硬體、系統、軟體、演算法、模型與資料集的 **平台策略**，客戶能在同一套基礎架構上快速部署多樣化 AI 應用，這種整合度與規模效應是其他競爭者難以在短期內追趕的【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  

綜合以上事實，NVIDIA 之所以成為 AI 發展的核心供應商，是因為它擁有領先的硬體技術、完整的軟體堆疊、龐大的開發者與合作夥伴生態系，以及在全球超級電腦與資料中心市場的絕對領先地位，形成難以被其他公司快速模仿的競爭壁壘。

records.query: 微軟是怎麼把 AI 塞進 Office 那些軟體裡的？
records.answer:
微軟是透過在 **Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端服務** 中加入 **Microsoft 365 Copilot** 等生成式 AI 功能，將 AI 直接嵌入其 Office 相關產品與服務，並以此提升每位使用者的收入與使用量【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】、【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #109】。

- **Microsoft 365 Copilot** 被納入 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端的產品組合，與 Microsoft 365 E5 一同成為推動「每位使用者收入」成長的主要動力，說明 AI 功能已在雲端服務層面與 Office 應用程式整合【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #109】。  
- 為支援 Copilot 的座位與使用量，微軟在 **AI 基礎建設** 上投入大量資源，包括計算容量與 AI 人才，這些投資直接反映在成本與營運支出的上升上【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #109】。  
- 微軟將 AI 視為 **Microsoft 365 Commercial** 的核心增值服務，透過「AI‑enabled 工具、功能與代理情境」在協作、分析、安全、合規等多個產品與服務領域提供 AI 能力，進一步說明 AI 已深度嵌入其生產力套件【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  

總結來說，微軟的做法是把生成式 AI（Microsoft 365 Copilot）作為 Microsoft 365 雲端服務的一部分，並在整個 Office 生態系統中加入 AI 功能與工具，同時加強 AI 基礎設施以支撐這些新功能的使用。

records.query: 亞馬遜最近在 AI 這塊砸錢做了什麼？跟哪家 AI 公司搭上線？
records.answer:
亞馬遜正大幅投入人工智慧領域，已向 Anthropic 投資 50 億美元（$5.0 billion）的非投票優先股，並與其簽訂最高 200 億美元（$20.0 billion）的資金授信安排，同時在 2026 年第一季投入 150 億美元（$15.0 billion）於 OpenAI 的 C 系列優先股，並承諾再以 350 億美元（$35.0 billion）購買後續增發股份【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #211】。  

- 這些投資顯示亞馬遜持續擴大 AI 相關資本支出，預計未來仍會持續投入 AI 計畫【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #211】。  
- 與 Anthropic 的合作包括已投資的 50 億美元（$5.0 billion）非投票優先股，以及一項最高 200 億美元（$20.0 billion）、於 30 個月後到期的授信設施，授信金額會根據 Anthropic 的算力交付里程碑逐步釋放【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】。  
- 與 OpenAI 的合作則在 2026 年第一季投入 150 億美元（$15.0 billion）於其 C 系列優先股，並透過一份承諾書（Letter Agreement）承諾再以 350 億美元（$35.0 billion）購買未來的增發股份【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】。  

因此，亞馬遜近期在 AI 方面的主要資金流向是 Anthropic 與 OpenAI 兩家 AI 公司。

Google 已將 AI 助手功能整合進搜尋引擎，讓使用者可以在 Google Search 中直接使用 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 來提出更自然且多層次的問題【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  

這些 AI 產品（AI Overviews 以及以 Gemini 為基礎的 AI Mode）已被嵌入搜尋體驗，提升了查詢的自然語言處理與多模態回應能力，同時也預示未來可能以不同方式貨幣化此類服務【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #289】。

Alphabet Inc. Our products and services have come a long way since the company was founded more than 25 years ago. While Google Search started as a way to find web pages, organized into ten blue links, we have driven technical advancements and product innovations that have transformed Google Search into a dynamic, multimodal experience. Large language models have made it possible to express more natural language queries, vastly improving the types of questions users can ask, and the quality of results. For example, AI Overviews makes it easier to ask Google anything and get a helpful response. AI Mode allows users to ask more nuanced questions that might have previously taken multiple searches, using Gemini’s advanced reasoning, thinking, and multimodal capabilities. This drive to make information more accessible and helpful has led us over the years to improve the discovery and creation of digital content both on the web and through platforms like Google Play and YouTube.

[GOOGL 10-K period 2025] •As we continue to grow our business and meet the evolving behaviors and needs of our users and customers, our revenue growth and mix along with our cost and margin profiles are being influenced by a number of factors, including:

Expanded AI Offerings in our Products and Services: The continuing evolution of the online world has contributed to the growth of our business. We expect that this evolution, including user engagement with AI products and services, will continue to benefit our business and our revenues. As we continue to incorporate AI into our products and services, such as with AI Overviews and AI Mode in Search, and with enterprise AI solutions on our Google Cloud Platform, we may monetize differently than our historical consumer and enterprise offerings which could affect revenue growth rates and margin trends. When developing new products and services we generally focus first on user experience and then on monetization. At the same time, we face increasing competition, including from other developers and providers of AI products and services, which may affect our revenues. Increasing Revenues Beyond Advertising: Revenues from cloud, consumer subscriptions, platforms, and devices, which may have differing characteristics than our advertising revenues, have grown over time. Certain of these revenues have been growing at a rate higher than our advertising revenues, becoming a larger percentage of our consolidated revenues, and we expect this trend to continue. The margins on these revenues vary significantly and are generally lower than the margins on our advertising revenues. Increased Investment in Technical Infrastructure: We continue to invest in capital expenditures as we scale our technical infrastructure, in particular for AI, to meet the demand of our users and enterprise customers and to support research internally. records.query: Meta 搞的那些 VR 眼鏡跟 AI，到底想往哪個方向發展？
records.answer:
Meta 正在把 VR/AR 眼鏡與 AI 助手結合，打造以沉浸式體驗與個人超智慧為核心的下一代計算平台，也就是公司所稱的「元宇宙」方向【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  

- **硬體路線**：Meta 透過 Reality Labs 推出 Meta Quest 系列 VR 裝置，並加入「passthrough」技術讓使用者在虛擬與現實之間保持感知；同時發展可穿戴 AI 眼鏡，包括 Ray‑Ban Meta、Oakley Meta 以及 2024 年揭露的 Orion 原型 AR 眼鏡，2025 年推出結合顯示鏡片的 Meta Ray‑Ban Display，並配備可透過肌電訊號控制的 Meta Neural Band 手環【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #72】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131】。  

- **AI 整合**：Meta AI 已在所有應用程式中提供對話式助理，並持續投資生成式 AI、超智慧模型，以提升內容排序、推薦引擎、廣告投放與測量等功能；公司亦開放 Llama 基礎模型，促進開源創新【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。  

- **策略目標**：公司將「從 2D 螢幕向沉浸式 AR/VR 轉移」視為未來的主要計算平台，期望透過 AI 與硬體的深度結合，提供更社交、實用且沉浸的體驗，同時以「個人超智慧」為長遠願景，讓每位使用者都能利用 AI 進行創作、學習與決策【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。  

- **合作與生態系**：Meta 與 Microsoft、NVIDIA、AMD、Broadcom 以及 OpenAI 等公司合作，支援其硬體與 AI 基礎建設，確保平台在計算需求與圖形處理上具備足夠的效能【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。  

- **風險與挑戰**：公司亦承認元宇宙的市場接受度仍不確定，且在消費性硬體與 AR/VR 技術上的經驗相對有限，可能使競爭對手更具優勢；因此，Reality Labs 的投資成效與資源分配仍是未來需持續觀察的重點【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #72】。
